components.text: Not a beast. A trail, no body. The grass lies inward, not with the wind.⚠ It watched from the empty that sits between leaves when you blink. Not a portal. I know portals: they have a rim and a hum. This waited until I wrote.
The quill snaps mid-word. No rating — nothing to rate. If this card is found without me, do not finish a beast. There was none. There was only what watched.
